trustedComparisonRule.arrayLength: If lengths differ and expected nonempty, select expected[min(actualLength,expectedLength-1)] own range/declarationRange when present; reject before accepting/trusting supplied rows.
trustedComparisonRule.consequences: Origin has parameter range. Root/owner/lastUse contain no own range, so owner and lastUse mutations have no primary. Group event has call range. Duplicate uses changes array length and selects expected last row argument range.
trustedComparisonRule.noInjectedRange: No invented whole function primary; all primaries are exact trusted expected ranges.
trustedComparisonRule.object: Recursively compare complete expected. An expected object replaces inherited primary only when that object itself has range/declarationRange; own sourcePath replaces sourceId. Sibling fields never propagate primary.
